ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT Agreement made as of this  day of _Mwre ,2007,between METROPOLITAN AVENUE 298-308 ASSSOCIATES, INC., having an address at c/o Daniel Miller, 861 Manhattan Avenue, Suite 14, Brooklyn, New York 11222 ("Grantor") and METROPOLITAN AVENUE 298-308 ASSSOCIATES, INC.,having an address at c/o Daniel Miller, 861 Manhattan Avenue, Suite 14, Brooklyn, New York 11222 ("Developer"). Grantor is the owner of certain land in the City of New York and County of Kings with the building and improvements thereon, known as 302-304 Metropolitan Avenue, designated as Block 2367, Lot 21 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the"Tax Map"), and being more particularly described in Schedule A-1 annexed hereto (said land replacements, additions, improvements and changes, thereof, being called "Grantor's Building" and said land and buildings and improvements being herein called "Premises A"). Developer owns certain land in the City of New York and County of Kings, with any existing building and improvements thereon, known as 308 Metropolitan Avenue, designated an Block 2367, Lot 23 on the Tax Map, and being more particularly described in Schedule A-2 annexed hereto (said parcel of land being herein called "Parcel B" and any existing building and improvements being herein called the "Existing Building" or the “Developer's Building"). Developer intends to demolish or renovate, in whole or in part, the Existing Building and to construct a new building or a renovation or alteration of the present building (said new building, or renovated or altered present building being herein called the "New Building") upon all or a portion of Parcel B which will contain or use more floor area and development rights than are now available for use on Parcel B pursuant to theZoningResolutionoftheCityofNewYork. The parties hereto desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for combining Parcel A and Parcel B into a single zoning lot for the purpose of transferring to Parcel B all of the Available Development Rights appurtenant to Parcel A and Grantor is willing to transfer such portion of the Available Development Rights to Parcel B in perpetuity; and The parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the "Declaration") in accordance with Section 12-10 of the Zoning B: &367 L: 212 23

Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lot") comprised of Parcel A and Parcel B; and The parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the mutual covenants hereinafter contained, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. As used herein: "Zoning Resolution" shall mean The Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the "City"), effective as of December 15, 1961. b. "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean all rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located as of the date hereof, (i) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, (ii) the inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution , and (iv) the further inclusion of any presently existing special development rights permitted under the current Zoning Resolution and which may be been authorized to be developed by any City Agency (including, without limitation, any Development Rights pursuant to the Inclusionary Housing Program as set forth in Section 23-90 through 23-94 of the Zoning Resolution and any amendments thereto existing as of the date hereof). C. "City Agencies" shall mean and refer to the City Planning Commission, Department of City Planning of the City of New York, the City Council, the New York City Department of Buildings, the Board of Standards and Appeals of the City of New York, the Landmarks Preservation Commission, the local Community Board, the Manhattan Borough President and any other relevant or necessary city d."Available Development Rights" shall mean all of the present Floor Area Development Rights which are appurtenant to the zoning lot in which Parcel A is located which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights currently utilized by the Building as of the date hereof. Interest," "Use," and "Bulk" shall have the meaning set forth in Section 12-10 of the ZoningResolution.
